scope: Microchip microcontrollers and digital signal controllers across official 8-bit, 16-bit, 32-bit and wireless MCU product surfaces
source_policy: Official Microchip product-family indexes are discovery surfaces; exact ordering codes and lifecycle must be captured from manufacturer product records. CMSIS packs, OpenOCD identifiers, parametric-search snippets and family names are discovery seeds only.
excluded_or_separate_surfaces: Analog, power, memory, interface and timing products
Wireless modules and connectivity controllers not identified as MCUs or MCU SoCs

reconciliation_policy.cross_segment_duplicates: deduplicate by exact ordering part number; conflicting lifecycle evidence is an error
reconciliation_policy.coverage_boundary: no Microchip-wide denominator until official family inventory and lifecycle/count semantics are independently audited

bulk_product_api.population_boundary: per-query response only; complete MCU/DSC family inventory is not established

findings.result: Rendered landing pages are narrative/featured-family surfaces and do not provide a complete family table or auditable total. Product-family examples found elsewhere remain discovery seeds only.
The page presents PIC24F GA and GB product-family links and mentions GC and DA in application groupings; it does not enumerate a complete PIC24 plus dsPIC family population.
The page groups PIC32C and SAM devices, with links to PIC32CX and SAM collateral; it is not a complete leaf-family or exact ordering-code table. PIC32M needs a separate family inventory.
The official page is a discovery surface and does not establish complete family membership or counts; legacy overlap with SAM remains to be reconciled.
The family surface combines wireless MCU ICs/SoCs and modules, requiring exact-part classification and de-duplication against the 32-bit lanes.

gate_1b_surface_audit.consequence: Keep population_boundary_validated false and global_active_denominator null. The API is documented as a promising source, but no live page-response fixture or independently reconciled per-family page totals is committed yet.

dfp_index_observation.scope: Device Family Pack supported device-name discovery only, not exact commercial SKU or lifecycle universe

family_query_seeds.query_execution_status: PIC10-12Fxxx_DFP: 27 seed device names, 26 bounded exact-SKU queries reconciled, one EOL device returns MCP NOT_FOUND
family_query_seeds.meaning: Family labels used to prepare a future per-family Product Data API query matrix. These labels are not exact ordering parts, API query semantics remain to be tested, and this set is not an exhaustive population.
